svg.text: Read huge rasters as bytes-free references with virtual tiles — carry paths + windows through the DataFrame, read pixels only when an operation needs them
Use as-is — or optimize to COG
Readers fan out — one window per tile
partitioned across executors · COG-optimized per-window range-reads
Compose ops — every rst_* takes either tile
auto-materialize · or virtualize_dir=… to stay bytes-free
~1,400–5,000× smaller than materialized → no ingest OOM
· pixels read lazily, one window at a time
· clip / transform / mosaic compose while staying virtual
· the DataFrame carries references, not pixels
decoded pixels in the row — ~12–24× faster repeat compute
· required to hand a tile to the heavyweight tier
databrickslabs/geobrix · lightweight tier (pyrx) · Serverless-ready · no JAR
